questions.question: The average age of Ram and Shyam is 28 years. If Rahim replaces Ram, then the average age will become 26 years. If Rahim replaces Shyam, then the average age will become 30 years. What are the respective ages of Ram, Shyam and Rahim?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of ages of **Ram**, **Shyam**, and **Rahim** = Sum of all given averages = 28 + 26 + 30 = 84 years.

**Ram's** age = 84 − (26 × 2) = 84 − 52 = 32 years.

**Shyam's** age = 84 − (30 × 2) = 84 − 60 = 24 years.

**Rahim's** age = 84 − (28 × 2) = 84 − 56 = 28 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 32 years, 24 years and 28 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of **Ram (R)** and **Shyam (S)** = 28 years

Average age of **Rahim (Rh)** and **Shyam (S)** = 26 years

Average age of **Ram (R)** and **Rahim (Rh)** = 30 years

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = Average × Total number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/753de4a53ace6769e6252d9562a4a510fdaa7cb06660198f408b1f1b89933fb7.png] 

⇒ R + S = 28 × 2 = 56 --- (i)

⇒ Rh + S = 26 × 2 = 52 --- (ii)

⇒ R + Rh = 30 × 2 = 60 --- (iii)

Adding equations (i), (ii), and (iii):

⇒ 2(R + S + Rh) = 56 + 52 + 60 = 168

⇒ R + S + Rh = 168 ÷ 2 = 84 --- (iv)

Subtracting (ii) from (iv):

⇒ **Ram's age (R)** = 84 − 52 = 32 years

Subtracting (iii) from (iv):

⇒ **Shyam's age (S)** = 84 − 60 = 24 years

Subtracting (i) from (iv):

⇒ **Rahim's age (Rh)** = 84 − 56 = 28 years

**∴ The correct answer is 32 years, 24 years and 28 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Definition of Average

Average is the ratio of the **sum of values** to the **number of values**. Formula: Average = Sum ÷ n.

Sum of Pairs Property

In a group of three (A, B, C), if sums of pairs (A+B, B+C, C+A) are known, the total sum (A+B+C) is exactly **half of the sum of the three pair sums**.

Weighted Average

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂ are combined, the new average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p

questions.question: The sum of the present ages of a father and his son is 94 years. 8 years ago their respective ages were in the ratio of 2 ∶ 1. After 10 years what will be the ratio of ages of father and son?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of **present ages** = 94 years.

Sum of ages 8 years ago = 94 − (2 × 8) = 78 years.

Divide 78 in the **ratio** 2 : 1 ⇒ Father = 52, Son = 26.

Age 10 years from now (Total gap of 18 years from past) ⇒ Father = 52 + 18 = 70, Son = 26 + 18 = 44.

Required ratio = 70 : 44 = 35 : 22.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 : 22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present sum = 94 years.

Ratio 8 years ago = 2 : 1.

**Formula Used:**

Total Age = Sum of individual ages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25e07a1943d999f845d7eb0454176a8e5c26ac9d949e774e36ded6acc44b71a2.png] 

Let the ages of **Father** and **Son** 8 years ago be 2x and x.

⇒ Present age of Father = 2x + 8

⇒ Present age of Son = x + 8

⇒ (2x + 8) + (x + 8) = 94

⇒ 3x + 16 = 94

⇒ 3x = 78

⇒ x = 26

⇒ Father's age 10 years from now = (2x + 8) + 10 = 2(26) + 18 = 52 + 18 = 70 years.

⇒ Son's age 10 years from now = (x + 8) + 10 = 26 + 18 = 44 years.

⇒ Ratio = 70 : 44 = 35 : 22.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 : 22.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two people remains constant throughout their lives, regardless of the time elapsed.

Age Sum Adjustment

To find the sum of ages 'n' years ago for 'k' people, subtract (n × k) from the present sum.

Ratio and Proportion in Ages

If ages are in ratio a : b, they can be represented as ax and bx to set up linear equations based on the given sum or difference.</p

questions.question: Two people A and B are at a distance of 220 km from each other at 10 ∶ 30 AM. After 30 minutes, A starts moving towards B at a speed of 40 km/hr while at 12 PM, B starts moving away from A at a speed of 30 km/hr. At what time will they meet on the next day?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Distance between A and B = 220 km

A starts moving towards B at 11 AM with speed of 40 km/hr

B starts moving Away from A at 12 PM with speed of 30 km/hr

At 12 PM A travelled 40 km

Now distance reduced to 180 km

Now both starts moving and difference between their speed is 10 km/hr

Since A’s speed is 10 km more than B so they will meet after 180 km / 10 km/hr = 18 hr = at 6 AM on next day

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: If {1over{(x−2)}} + x = 8, then what is the value of {1over{(x−2)}²} + (x − 2)²?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Subtract 2 from both sides of the **given equation**: (x − 2) + 1/(x − 2) = 6.

Apply the **algebraic shortcut**: If k + 1/k = n, then k² + 1/k² = n² − 2.

Substitute n = 6 into the formula: 6² − 2 = 36 − 2 = 34.

**∴ The correct answer is 34.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 1/(x − 2) + x = 8

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de81ca58c183426f4e461e1558ac17e0b9f72ea0b5a6c0bdb38b1a84e692ec64.png] 

⇒ 1/(x − 2) + x = 8

⇒ x − 2 + 1/(x − 2) = 8 − 2

⇒ (x − 2) + 1/(x − 2) = 6

⇒ **Squaring both sides:** [(x − 2) + 1/(x − 2)]² = 6²

⇒ (x − 2)² + [1/(x − 2)]² + 2 × (x − 2) × [1/(x − 2)] = 36

⇒ (x − 2)² + 1/(x − 2)² + 2 = 36

⇒ (x − 2)² + 1/(x − 2)² = 36 − 2 = 34

**∴ The correct answer is 34.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Expansion

The square of a binomial is given by (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab and (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab.

Reciprocal Property

If the sum of a number and its **reciprocal** is k (i.e., x + 1/x = k), then the sum of their squares is always k² − 2.

Higher Power Relation

If x + 1/x = k, then the sum of their cubes is given by x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.</p

questions.question: A man earns a profit of 20 percent by selling a calculator for a certain price. If he sells that calculator at double the price, then what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Cost Price (CP) be 100 units.

Selling Price (SP) with 20% profit = 120 units.

New Selling Price = Double the initial SP = 120 × 2 = 240 units.

New Profit = New SP − CP = 240 − 100 = 140 units.

Profit % = (140 ÷ 100) × 100 = 140%.

**∴ The correct answer is 140%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Profit percentage initially = 20%

Condition: The new selling price is double the initial selling price.

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Selling Price (SP) − Cost Price (CP)

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100<

questions.question: In an equilateral triangle ABC, P is the centroid of this triangle. Side of ΔABC is 16√3 cm. What is the distance of point P from side BC?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In an **equilateral triangle**, the **centroid** is the same as the **incenter**.

The distance from the **centroid** to any side is the **inradius (r)** of the triangle.

Shortcut formula: Inradius (r) = side ÷ (2√3)

⇒ Distance = (16√3) ÷ (2√3)

⇒ Distance = 16 ÷ 2 = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of **equilateral triangle ABC** (a) = 16√3 cm.

Point **P** is the **centroid**.

**Formula Used:**

Height (h) of equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 2) × side

Centroid divides the median in the ratio 2 : 1 from the vertex.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8bf4033cc814d32087adddac4337be24a337b831ba12ea2556dacd3d2773378.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Height (AD) = (√3 ÷ 2) × 16√3

⇒ AD = (16 × 3) ÷ 2

⇒ AD = 24 cm

⇒ The **centroid (P)** divides **median AD** in ratio **AP : PD = 2 : 1**.

⇒ Distance of P from side BC = PD

⇒ PD = (1 ÷ (2 + 1)) × AD

⇒ PD = (1 ÷ 3) × 24

⇒ PD = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equilateral Triangle Centroid

In an equilateral triangle, the centroid, orthocenter, circumcenter, and incenter all lie at the same point.

Inradius and Circumradius

For an equilateral triangle with side a, Inradius (r) = a / (2√3) and Circumradius (R) = a / √3. Note that R = 2r.

Median Property

The centroid divides each median into two segments with lengths in the ratio 2 : 1 from the vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side.</p

questions.question: Rama alone can do a work in 5 days working 4 hours a day. Seema alone can do the same work in 3 days working 10 hours a day. How many hours do they need to work together in a day to complete the same work in 6 days?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Rama can finish the work in 5 days working 4 hours a day, that's 5 × 4 = 20 hours.

Seema can finish the work in 3 days working 10 hours a day, that's 3 × 10 = 30 hours.

So, we can say that Rama's work rate is 1/20 of the work per hour, and Seema's work rate is 1/30 of the work per hour.

So, their combined rate is 1/20 + 1/30 = (3 + 2)/60 = 5/60 = 1/12 of the work per hour.

If they want to finish the work in 6 days, and they work together at the combined rate of 1/12 of the work per hour, then they need to work:

6 days × x hours/day = 1 work

x = 1 work / (6 days &a
mp;times; 1/12 work/hour)

x = 1 / (6/12) = 2 hours/day

**So, Rama and Seema need to work together for 2 hours each day to finish the work in 6 days.**

questions.question: What is the value of (x + 1) (x² − x + 1)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **Algebraic Identity** for the **sum of two cubes**.

Standard Formula: (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) = a³ + b³

Here, let **a = x** and **b = 1**.

Substitute these values: (x + 1)(x² − (x)(1) + 1²) = x³ + 1³ = x³ + 1.

**∴ The correct answer is x³ + 1.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (x + 1)(x² − x + 1)

**Method:** Expand the brackets using the **distributive property** of multiplication.

⇒ x(x² − x + 1) + 1(x² − x + 1)

⇒ (x × x²) − (x × x) + (x × 1) + (1 × x²) − (1 × x) + (1 × 1)

⇒ x³ − x² + x + x² − x + 1

⇒ x³ + (−x² + x²) + (x − x) + 1

⇒ x³ + 0 + 0 + 1

⇒ x³ + 1

**∴ The correct answer is x³ + 1.**

**__Additional Information__**

Difference of Two Cubes

The identity for the subtraction of cubes is a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²).

Perfect Cube Binomial

The expansion of (a + b)³ is a³ + 3a²b + 3ab² + b³, which is different from a³ + b³.

Difference of Squares

Another essential identity is a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b).</p

questions.question: In an examination, 45 percent of students passed in history and 60 percent of students passed in Hindi. If 8 percent of students failed in both subjects, then what percentage of students passed in both subjects?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let's denote the total number of students as 100% 

The students who passed in history are 45% and those who passed in Hindi are 60%.

So, the total percentage who passed either in history or Hindi (or both) is 45% + 60% = 105%.

But this sum also includes the students who passed in both subjects twice (once for history and once for Hindi).

Also, we know that 8% of students failed in both subjects. That means the total percentage of students who passed in at least one subject is 100% - 8% = 92%.

Percentage of students who passed in both subjects = Total pass percentage in history or Hindi - the percentage of students who passed in at least one subject

= 105% - 92% = 13%

**So, 13% of students passed in both subjects.**

questions.question: If the heights of two cylinders are in the ratio of 2 ∶ 3 and their-radius are in the ratio of 6 ∶ 5, then what is the ratio of the volumes of the cylinders?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Volumes** = (Ratio of **Radii**)² × (Ratio of **Heights**)

Ratio of Volumes = (6 / 5)² × (2 / 3)

Ratio of Volumes = (36 / 25) × (2 / 3)

Ratio of Volumes = 12/25 × 2 = 24 / 25

**∴ The correct answer is 24 : 25.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **heights** (h₁ : h₂) = 2 : 3

Ratio of **radii** (r₁ : r₂) = 6 : 5

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24dd9ca9ff13aa09606cbcedb0b983f01a053056954fdb46cc9acf2939da2831.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder (V) = πr²h

**Calculations:**

⇒ V₁ = π × (6x)² × (2y) = π × 36x² × 2y = 72πx²y

⇒ V₂ = π × (5x)² × (3y) = π × 25x² × 3y = 75πx²y

⇒ V₁ : V₂ = 72πx²y : 75πx²y

⇒ V₁ : V₂ = 72 : 75

⇒ V₁ : V₂ = 24 : 25 (Dividing both sides by 3)

**∴ The correct answer is 24 : 25.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cylinder

The amount of space occupied by a three-dimensional object is its volume. For a cylinder, V = πr²h.

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the curved surface of a cylinder excluding its base and top is given by CSA = 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The sum of the curved surface area and the areas of the two circular bases is TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Ratio Property of Volume

If heights are equal, the volume ratio is the ratio of the squares of the radii: V₁/V₂ = (r₁/r₂)².</p

questions.question: If 2Cos² θ − 9 cos θ + 7 = 0, then what is the value of cos² θ + sec² θ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2Cos2 θ − 9 cos θ + 7 = 0

**Concept Used:**

cos θ = 1/sec θ 

**Calculation:**

2Cos2 θ − 9 cos θ + 7 = 0

Solving for secθ, we have a quadratic equation in secθ:

2Cos2 θ − 9 cos θ + 7 = 0

This can be factored as follows:

(2 cos θ - 7)(cos θ - 1) = 0.

Setting each factor equal to zero gives the solutions cos θ = 3.5 or cos θ = 1.

As cos θ = 3.5 is not possible so we take cos θ = 1.

cos2 θ + sec2 θ

1/sec2 θ + sec2 θ

1 + 1 = 2

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: A sum amounts to Rs. 6580 in 2 years and amounts to Rs. 7896 in 3 years on compound interest (compounding annually) at the same rate of interest. What is the annual rate of interest?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

If the sum amounts to Rs. 6580 in 2 years and Rs. 7896 in 3 years, the difference (Rs. 7896 - Rs. 6580 = Rs. 1316) would be the interest earned in the third year.

So, the interest for the third year, Rs. 1316, was obtained from the amount that was there at the end of two years, which is Rs. 6580.

Interest for third year = Sum after 2 years × annual interest rate

1316 = 6580 × r

Solving this equation for r gives us:

r = 1316/6580 × 100 = 20%

**So, the annual rate of interest is 20%.**
